metadata.description: Reviewed, pinned Claude Code plugins, skills and mods for BarryOS. Every external entry is pinned to the exact commit that was reviewed. See README.md.

plugins.name: barryos-kit
plugins.description: Het BarryOS-pakket: installeert alle goedgekeurde plugins uit deze marketplace in één keer.

plugins.name: ponytail-skills
plugins.description: Lazy senior dev skills: reuse first, smallest change that works.

plugins.name: thermonuclear-review
plugins.description: Strict structural code-quality review.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands and shows what they would change. A safety net, not a security boundary.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: UI/UX design intelligence: styles, palettes, typography, UX rules (local only).

plugins.name: ui-ux-design-studio
plugins.description: OPT-IN: logo/icon/brand generation via external AI image services (needs your own API key).

plugins.name: graphify
plugins.description: Codebase knowledge graph (opt-in per project; needs uv tool install 'graphifyy==0.9.103').

plugins.name: rea
plugins.description: Reverse engineering with agents (MCP server + skill): app behavior, JS bundles, Android, native binaries. Opt-in; heavy (~52 MB), uses local tools like Ghidra/LLDB/mitmproxy when present.

plugins.name: terminal-browser
plugins.description: OPT-IN ONLY. In-terminal browser. Needs an external binary (curl|bash), sends telemetry by default. Set TERMINAL_BROWSER_NO_TELEMETRY=1.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: Workflow skills: brainstorming, plans, TDD, debugging, code review.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Anthropic: PR code review.

plugins.name: code-simplifier
plugins.description: Anthropic: simplify recently changed code.

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.description: Anthropic: security guidance while editing.

plugins.name: security-scan
plugins.description: Anthropic Claude Security scanner (plugin id claude-security).

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Anthropic: create and evaluate skills.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Terse replies, fewer output tokens.

plugins.name: context-mode
plugins.description: Keeps large tool output out of the context window.

plugins.name: mem
plugins.description: Persistent memory across sessions (plugin id claude-mem).

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Anthropic: distinctive frontend design guidance.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Design critique, polish and UI quality.

plugins.name: dev-skills
plugins.description: All 12 BarryOS project skills: Vercel React/composition/view-transitions, web design guidelines, design critique, landing pages, taste, image-to-code, Playwright, Supabase, skillui.

plugins.name: vercel
plugins.description: Vercel platform skills and tools.

plugins.name: swift-lsp
plugins.description: OPT-IN: Swift language server.
